methods_quotes.q: Changes in current use since 2023 were evaluated using t- tests; p-values <0.05 were considered statistically significant.
Weighted prevalence estimates, 95% CIs, and population totals were calculated using SAS-callable SUDAAN software (version 11.0.4; RTI International).
Data were weighted to account for complex survey design and to adjust for nonresponse.
Data were statistically unreliable because of an unweighted denominator <50 or a relative SE >30%.
